stories.title: Stricter bird flu rules aim to prevent spread of virus
stories.summary: The risk to humans is very low and transmission from birds to humans is rare, scientists say.

stories.title: Labour lost its connection with voters, says Welsh leader
stories.summary: On Saturday, Labour will publish a review into its historic election defeat in May’s Senedd election.

stories.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones says US move humbled her before big break with Steven Spielberg
stories.summary: The Swansea-born star got her big break in The Mask of Zorro which cemented her place as an A-lister.

stories.title: Mother whose newborn died after failed hospital checks was 'terrified and alone'
stories.summary: Sonny Taylor died after hospital staff failed to wake up his mother, Eve, for monitoring.

stories.title: Wales' public services impacted by global Microsoft outage
stories.summary: Schools, GPs and businesses across the globe have been hit with the outage affecting Outlook and Teams.

stories.title: 'Hardest challenge of my life' - Owain Wyn Evans completes Children in Need ride
stories.summary: Owain Wyn Evans cycled almost 400 miles, setting off from Glasgow and finishing in Cardiff.

stories.title: Man appears in court charged with possessing firearm after car hit by gunshots
stories.summary: David Joyce appeared at Swansea Magistrates' Court and spoke only to confirm his name, age and address.

stories.title: Reform could try to remove Senedd presiding officer over member's speaking ban
